description: Fix dark mode support across all screens by replacing hardcoded AppColors references with Theme.of(context) colors. Ensure background, text, and card colors all follow the active theme.
steps: Fix lib/features/home/screens/home_screen.dart: Replace AppColors.background with theme.scaffoldBackgroundColor, AppColors.surface with theme.colorScheme.surface, AppColors.textPrimary with theme.colorScheme.onSurface, AppColors.textSecondary with theme.colorScheme.onSurface.withOpacity(0.6). Keep AppColors.primary, AppColors.success, AppColors.error, AppColors.warning as-is since those are accent colors.
Fix lib/features/home/widgets/campaign_card.dart and creator_card.dart: Same pattern - replace text/background color references with theme-based colors.
Fix lib/features/auth/screens/login_screen.dart and register_screen.dart: Replace hardcoded AppColors.textPrimary/textSecondary/background with theme equivalents.
Fix lib/features/campaigns/screens/ - all campaign screens: Replace hardcoded color references.
Fix lib/features/wallet/screens/wallet_screen.dart, deposit_screen.dart, withdraw_screen.dart: Replace hardcoded colors.
Fix admin_app/lib/features/ screens that use AppColors.background directly as Scaffold backgroundColor - replace with theme.scaffoldBackgroundColor. Same for text colors.
Fix lib/features/auth/screens/splash_screen.dart: Replace backgroundColor: Colors.white with theme.scaffoldBackgroundColor.

Scan and fix remaining screens (shop, messages, notifications, orders, etc.) for hardcoded AppColors.background/textPrimary/textSecondary/surface/card usage. Replace with Theme.of(context) equivalents.
acceptance_criteria: No screen uses AppColors.background as scaffold background - all use theme.scaffoldBackgroundColor
No screen uses AppColors.textPrimary for text - all use theme.colorScheme.onSurface
No screen uses AppColors.textSecondary for text - all use theme.colorScheme.onSurface.withOpacity(0.6) or similar
No screen uses AppColors.surface for card/container backgrounds - all use theme.colorScheme.surface
AppColors.primary, AppColors.success, AppColors.error, AppColors.warning remain unchanged (accent colors)
All screens respect dark mode when toggled
verification: Grep for 'AppColors.background' in lib/features/ and admin_app/lib/features/ - should have zero occurrences (except in theme definition files)
Grep for 'AppColors.textPrimary' in screen/widget files - should have zero occurrences
Grep for 'Colors.white' used as background color in Scaffold - should have zero occurrences
